candidate.claim: Hexadecimal/binary/octal number formatting prefixes '0x'/'0b'/'0o' directly to argument.toString(radix). For negative values this yields '0x-A' / '0b-1010' / '0o-12' instead of '-0xA' etc., and for Infinity/NaN/fractions it yields syntactically invalid literals, so the returned JS cannot be evaluated.
candidate.title: Negative numbers produce invalid hex/binary/octal literals
